title: Join Us
intro: We are building an interdisciplinary team of scientists interested in immune specificity, translational immunology, and the mechanisms that connect antigen recognition to human disease. We welcome applicants who are curious, collaborative, thoughtful, and excited to bridge mechanistic biology with clinical impact.
who_we_are_looking_for: PhD students interested in immunology, functional genomics, synthetic biology, and quantitative approaches to studying immune recognition
Postdoctoral fellows with strong scientific training, creativity, and interest in building ambitious projects at the interface of basic and translational immunology
Research staff with experience in molecular biology, cell engineering, flow cytometry, or next-generation sequencing workflows
Master’s students seeking immersive research experience in immunology and translational science
Undergraduate students who are eager to learn, contribute to a collaborative team, and gain hands-on experience in research
how_to_apply: Please email a CV, a brief statement of research interests, and contact information for 2 to 3 references.
If applicable, you are welcome to include a representative manuscript, preprint, or short summary of past research experience.
In your message, please note your current training stage and which research area of the lab most closely aligns with your interests and goals.
culture: Our lab values rigorous science, open communication, generosity, and strong mentorship. We aim to create an environment where people can grow as scientists, contribute thoughtfully to a team, and do their best work in a culture that is collaborative, supportive, and intellectually ambitious.

open_positions.title: Postdoctoral Fellow
open_positions.details: We are interested in candidates excited about antigen discovery, T cell biology, and translational immunology. Projects may span autoimmunity, infection, cancer, and immune ligand discovery, depending on background and mutual interest.

open_positions.title: Research Associate
open_positions.details: We welcome applicants interested in functional genomics, pooled screening, molecular immunology, and experimental platform development. Prior experience with cell culture, flow cytometry, cloning, or sequencing-based workflows is helpful.

open_positions.title: Master’s Student
open_positions.details: We welcome master’s students interested in gaining rigorous research experience in immunology, data analysis, and experimental design within a collaborative and mentorship-driven environment.

open_positions.title: Undergraduate Student
open_positions.details: We welcome undergraduate students who are excited to learn, contribute to team science, and build foundational research skills through hands-on experience in the lab.
